$comment: Single source of truth for every environment variable KernelHub reads. Consumed by src/lib/env/schema.ts (zod, /api/health?verbose=1) and scripts/check-env.mjs (plain JS). A unit test keeps this file and .env.example in sync.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
vars.description: Supabase publishable/anon key used by the browser and SSR client.

vars.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
vars.description: Supabase service-role key (server only). JWT payload role must be service_role.

vars.name: DSQL_ENDPOINT
vars.description: Aurora DSQL cluster host, or localhost / 127.0.0.1 for plain Postgres.

vars.name: MARKETING_TRACKING_SECRET
vars.description: HMAC secret signing marketing open/click/unsubscribe links. Required in production. openssl rand -hex 32.

vars.name: MARKETING_TRACKING_SECRET_PREVIOUS
vars.description: Previous tracking secret kept during rotation so already-sent links still verify.

vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
vars.description: Structured log threshold: debug | info | warn | error | silent.

vars.name: LOG_FORMAT
vars.description: Set to json to force JSON log lines outside production (production always logs JSON).

vars.name: METRICS_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token for GET /api/metrics (Prometheus). Endpoint returns 404 when unset. openssl rand -hex 32.

vars.name: OPERATOR_ORG_ID
vars.description: Org id/data id of the platform operator workspace: enables platform alert rules and deployment-wide queue numbers on System health.

vars.name: MARKETING_TRACKING_ACCEPT_LEGACY
vars.description: Set to false (with MARKETING_TRACKING_SECRET set) to stop accepting tracking links signed with the legacy CRON_SECRET-derived key, once old links have aged out.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS
vars.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops in X-Forwarded-For (client IP is taken that many entries from the right). Default 1 on Vercel/production, 0 otherwise.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
vars.description: Canonical public origin (links in emails, OAuth redirects, portal URLs).

vars.name: ATTACHMENTS_LOCAL_DIR
vars.description: Dev-only: store attachments in this local directory instead of Supabase Storage (ignored in production).

vars.name: DB_USER
vars.description: Plain Postgres user (only when DSQL_ENDPOINT is localhost/127.0.0.1).

vars.name: AWS_REGION
vars.description: AWS region for Aurora DSQL IAM signing and DynamoDB.

vars.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
vars.description: AWS credentials (DynamoDB messages/analytics, DSQL IAM when no instance role).

vars.name: DYNAMODB_ANALYTICS_TABLE
vars.description: DynamoDB table for site analytics events.

vars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
vars.description: OpenAI key; only used for social post image thumbnails.

vars.name: AI_CREDIT_MARKUP
vars.description: Multiplier applied to raw LLM cost when charging credits.

vars.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
vars.description: Fine-grained PAT for repo review and site publishing.

vars.name: EMAIL_PROVIDER
vars.description: Outbound email transport for the platform mailer.

vars.name: EMAIL_FROM
vars.description: Sender for notifications, invites, quotes and invoices.

vars.name: GMAIL_USER
vars.description: Gmail/SMTP user when EMAIL_PROVIDER=gmail (SMTP_USER also accepted).

vars.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
vars.description: Twilio auth token; also verifies inbound webhook signatures.

vars.name: TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM
vars.description: WhatsApp sender; falls back to TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.

vars.name: TWILIO_SKIP_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION
vars.description: Skip Twilio webhook signature checks (local only).

vars.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
vars.description: Encrypts per-tenant integration credentials at rest (openssl rand -base64 32). Required for OAuth integrations and payments.

vars.name: PLANS_ENFORCED
vars.description: true = enforce KernelHub plan limits and feature gates (HTTP 402 plan_limit). false = everything allowed; usage is still measured and shown.

vars.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
vars.description: Cloudflare Turnstile server secret (signup bot check).

vars.name: PUBLIC_WIDGET_ORIGINS
vars.description: Comma-separated origins allowed on public widget/lead/analytics endpoints.

vars.name: WEBHOOKS_ALLOW_INSECURE
vars.description: 1 = allow http://localhost webhook targets (never in production).

vars.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Google OAuth client for Gmail inbox sync and Google Calendar sync.

vars.name: MS_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Microsoft OAuth client for Outlook inbox sync and Outlook Calendar sync.

vars.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
vars.description: Web Push VAPID public key (node scripts/gen-vapid-keys.mjs).

vars.name: VAPID_SUBJECT
vars.description: mailto: or https: contact; falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PWA
vars.description: 1 = register the service worker in dev builds.

vars.name: RATE_LIMIT_STORE
vars.description: Rate-limit backend; use db when running more than one instance.

vars.name: SSO_ENABLED
vars.description: 1 = show the SSO button and enable SAML/SCIM endpoints.

vars.name: SSO_PROVIDER_NAME
vars.description: Label shown on the SSO login button.

vars.name: KH_BASE_URL
vars.description: Base URL for scripts/seed-demo.mjs and scripts/smoke.mjs.
